text:
Labs/MECP2 is a 19-run campaign on the methyl-CpG-binding domain of MeCP2, dated 26–28 Aug 2025. The contract is findings.json v3.3. The human abstract (abstract.txt) is titled Computational Audit and Verification of a Rescue Strategy for Rett Syndrome-Associated MECP2 Mutations and is attributed to “The Gemini Auditing Group.” There is no load-bearing X field note for this campaign in the current compile. Cite GitHub.

The engine’s own abstract reports 15 CONFIRMED, 1 DEVIATION, 3 INDETERMINATE. Isolated-MBD baselines (Runs 1–3) are INDETERMINATE because diagnostics_timeseries.csv is missing. Run 5 (unrescued R106W–DNA) was contracted as unstable (RMSD ≥ 20 Å) and the definitive tail median came back 3.06 Å — DEVIATION, not a quiet pass. Do not cite this campaign as 19/19 clean. This compile independently reproduced those three counts from the bound CSVs on 7 Sep 2026. Start there: Run this first on the WetLabEngine protein audit page.

Thesis in the contract

MECP2 MBD Rett mutations destabilize DNA binding but can be rescued by stabilizing the encounter complex; WT complex is inherently stable.

Machine test: count_runs_meeting where best_final_RMSD_A ≤ 4.5 must be ≥ 3. The audit abstract says 16 runs met that cutoff, so the thesis constraint passed. Passing a count constraint is not a therapeutic claim.

Campaign map

What a researcher should not write

Do not write “MECP2 folding is solved.” Full-length WT is treated as IDP-like; the campaign is about the MBD–DNA interface.
Do not write “R106W is unstable because RMSD is high.” Run 5 is the counterexample: a low RMSD that failed the instability claim.
Do not write “interface annealing is a Rett therapy.” It is an in-silico protocol that seated mutant complexes in this coarse-grained model.
Do not promote the thesis implications (ligand-design avenues, generalizable rescue) to Supported. They are manuscript discussion, Restricted at most.

Inside this 19-run coarse-grained campaign, InterfaceAnneal seated R106W and R133C MBD–DNA complexes to near-native RMSD, and post-anneal challenges held. The WT–DNA complex is a stable positive control. This is not a Rett therapy, not all-atom MD, and not a folding oracle.

Run 5 is a recorded DEVIATION: the unrescued-mutant contract (RMSD ≥ 20 Å) did not match the definitive 3.06 Å tail. Runs 1–3 are INDETERMINATE for missing diagnostics CSV. Cite the mismatch; do not drop it.
